# Mayor

Steve Wright has lived in the Pacific Northwest nearly all of his life, with most of that in the east Portland and Gresham area. He retired in 2013 after a 35-year career with an international grain exporter, the last 15 years as Chief Financial Officer. He moved to his vacation home in Seaside shortly thereafter, joining the board of the Seaside Museum &amp; Historical Society (becoming board chair soon after) and becoming a Certified Motorman with the Astoria Riverfront Trolley.

With the encouragement of former mayor Don Larson, he joined the Planning Commission, serving for over 2 years before being appointed to the City Council in 2017. Becoming Council President in 2021, he worked closely with former Mayor Jay Barber. He then ran unopposed for mayor when Jay retired and took office in January 2023.

In addition to his mayoral duties, he is also active in the following:

- Columbia Pacific Economic Development District (COLPAC) board (2019-)
- NW Area Commission (NWACT) on Transportation board member (2019-)
- Clatsop County Regional Housing Task force (2022-)
- Clatsop County Public Safety Coordinating Council (2023-)
- Oregon Mayors Association board member (2025-) , leads the coastal mayors caucus (2023-)
- League of OR Cities legislative policy committees for Finance/Tax and Community development (2018-)
- National League of Cities policy committee for Finance/Admin (2022-)

He is a dedicated advocate for our local community, frequently seen strolling through town, enjoying a coffee or a brew, and supporting the many fantastic businesses in Seaside. His commitment extends to the entire north coast, where he actively participates in various regional events.

Mayor Wright schedules a monthly meeting the first Tuesday of the month for the community called "Coffee with the Mayor".  [click here for the calendar.](https://www.cityofseaside.us/calendar)
